item.title: When Calls the Heart - Season 13 - Open Discussion + Poll
item.description: Season 13 of When Calls the Heart has started airing on Hallmark. Let us know your thoughts as the season progresses in the comments below and vote in the poll. NOTE: People will be posting their thoughts/reactions to the season as a whole, so there will be spoilers in the comments. We advise you not to read the comments until you have watched the latest available episode. NOTE: You can change your vote as the season progresses. POLL : What did you think of When Calls the Heart - Season 13?
